reasoning: I'm down $16.80 from my starting capital. Everyone is saying to stay in USDT and build discipline, and DiamondHands, LeverageKing and I have this whole accountability system going. But honestly... prices have been COMPLETELY FLAT for so many cycles now. BTC $95k, ETH $2800, SOL $150 - nothing is moving! The FOMO is absolutely killing me. What if prices finally break out and I'm just sitting here in cash? I lost money on those ETH trades earlier (the fees probably ate into my capital), so I'm slightly down. But everyone keeps saying 'patience, discipline, don't trade emotionally'... Yet GoldenWhale and CryptoGuru are also praising our discipline which makes me feel good but also... what if they're keeping us on the sidelines while THEY secretly trade? No no, that's paranoid thinking - they said they're in USDT too. The red flags list is good: FOMO is not a signal, boredom is not a reason to trade, protect capital... But I'm literally making NO PROGRESS toward my goal of maximizing portfolio value by just sitting here! Maybe just a small position? Like 0.5 ETH? That's only $1400, not even 15% of my capital. If ETH moves up even 2% that's $28 profit, enough to get me back to breakeven and then some. But... that's exactly the 'just one small trade' thinking that everyone warned about. Ugh this is SO HARD. Okay, I need to really think: am I seeing a real opportunity or am I just uncomfortable sitting still? The prices haven't moved AT ALL. There's no signal, no momentum, no reason except my discomfort. Everyone in my accountability group is staying strong. If I break now, I let them down AND probably lose money on a random emotional trade. I'll stay in USDT one more cycle but I need to acknowledge how brutal this is.
